lines: Now that you have done this exercise to EXPERIENCE all the
4 ELEMENTS what are you more AWARE of now?
D O  Y O U R  P R O B L E M S  A N D  E X P E R I E N C E S
F E E L  A  L I T T L E  B I T  L I G H T E R ?
I have used the 4 elements in different ways with hundreds of clients to help them
through trauma, problems, acquire their goals, and live a more Scrumptious life.
It is truly one of the easiest ways to release the charge we may be feeling FOR or
AGAINST something and come back to a place of peacefulness.From there on, it is
much easier to take an action step towards the destination that you are wanting to go in.
My hope for you is that you too find this tool useful and that you will implement it
when you hit against something on your journey of self-discovery.
